parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of hazards for the specified company. By default, only active hazards are returned; pass all=true to include inactive ones. Hazards categorize the type of danger associated with an incident.

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with a status of 'active'.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction. Use the value to sort ascending, or prefix with a hyphen (e.g. -name) to sort descending.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: When true, returns both active and inactive hazards. When omitted or false, only active hazards are returned.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

name.description: Display name of the hazard, translated to the requested locale. For the untranslated original name, see name_key.

name_key.description: Untranslated original name of the hazard. Use for programmatic matching when locale-independent identification is needed.

active.description: Whether this hazard is active and available for selection when recording incidents.

global.description: Whether this hazard is a Procore-provided default. Global hazards cannot be renamed or deleted.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this hazard was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this hazard was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
